remarks: Sunny, spacious & pet-friendly, this contemporary townhome is located in convenient & desirable Greenfield! Situated on the brim of Greenwich & close to UCONN + downtown Stamford, living is easy here - bright and warm with an abundance of windows and sunshine! Chic, entertainer's kitchen features stunning granite countertops, rich cabinetry, stainless appliances and opens to the large living/dining area. You'll delight in the private washer/dryer upstairs, private entrance & parking for 2-cars. You'll also reap the economic benefits of green-built certification construction, natural gas heat, tankless hot water, central air AND NO ADDITIONAL FEES. Pets are permitted in Greenfield. 2 dogs 35lbs. , 1 dog 60 lbs., 2 cats or 1 dog and 1 cat are allowed. Aggressive breeds are not permitted. Greenfield is a no smoking community.  Interested applicants please submit Greenfield Application found in supplements and credit check through applyconnect ONLY.
